requirements.verbatim_text: Bids Due: July 24,2026 by 10:00 a.m. Central Time
Deadline for Submission of Bids (NOTE: Bids must be RECEIVED by TWC by the deadline) July 24,2026 at 10:00 AM Central Time
Bidder must submit its Bid to TWC in accordance with the due date and time as indicated in this Schedule of Events or as changed via a notification of an Addendum posted to the ESBD.
Only bids on items conforming exactly to these specifications, which include proposing only the brand name(s), make and model number(s) specified, will be considered in determining an award.
a. Successful Bidder must provide the acSoft Inc ServiceNow Power BI plug-in connector.
b. Successful Bidder must provide key features of the acSoft Inc ServiceNow Power BI plug-in connector which include:
1. The ability to export any ServiceNow tables and fields (including Custom tables and fields);
2. The ability to include any amount of tables and fields to your Data Source;
3. The ability to create any amount of Data Sources (data sets);

4. No limitations in exported data. To reduce the server load during the export process, the application provides the server-side pagination of data over the OData protocol (limited to 1.000 rows per page);
5. Advanced filtering options to manage data selection and export only the relevant information;
6. Robust permission settings and access management for secure data sharing;
7. Dot-walking mechanism for exporting Reference type data, allowing easy access and inclusion of fields from related tables;
8. Incremental refresh support for efficient Power BI reports and dashboards updates without reimporting the entire dataset;
9. Power Query support (merge ServiceNow with other data sources, transform data and load it into Power BI Desktop with no-code experience);
10. Pre-typed data, eliminating the need for manual conversion to target types such as integer, boolean, decimal, etc.

If Bidder asserts that information provided in its Bid is exempt from disclosure under the Texas Public Information Act, Bidder must mark and submit two separate, searchable Portable Document Format (PDF) copies (Original Bid and “Public Information Act Copy,” including attachments, of the Original Bid) as identified below.

Within five (5) Business days from Contract execution, the Successful Bidder must submit a “Public Information Act Copy” of the Original Executed Contract (in addition to the original executed contract) to the TWC contract manager by email.
a. The copy must be clearly marked as “Public Information Act Copy” on the front page in large, bold, capitalized letters (the size of, or equivalent to, 12-point Arial font or larger);
b. Each portion Successful Bidder claims is exempt from public disclosure must be redacted (blacked out);
c. Successful Bidder must identify, adjacent to each redaction, the claimed exemption from disclosure.

SUBMISSION OF ANY DOCUMENT TO TWC IN RESPONSE TO THIS SOLICITATION CONSTITUTES AN IRREVOCABLE WAIVER AND AGREEMENT BY BIDDER TO FULLY INDEMNIFY THE STATE OF TEXAS AND TWC FROM ANY CLAIM OF INFRINGEMENT AGAINST THE STATE OF TEXAS AND TWC REGARDING THE INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS OF BIDDER OR ANY THIRD PARTY FOR ANY MATERIALS SUBMITTED TO TWC BY BIDDER.

For the duration of any Contract resulting from this Solicitation, the Successful Bidder shall acquire insurance, bonds, or both, with financially sound and reputable independent insurers, in the type and amount listed in Attachment 1 – TWC Terms and Conditions.
It will be the Bidder’s responsibility to recommend to TWC alternative methods of insuring the Contract.
Any alternatives proposed by Bidder should be accompanied by a detailed explanation regarding Bidder's inability to obtain the required insurance and/or bonds.

During the term of the Contract or any extension or renewal thereof, the Successful Bidder shall notify TWC in writing of any substantial change in the ownership or control of the Successful Bidder as soon as possible, but no later than thirty (30) days prior to its occurrence.
Successful Bidder must also notify TWC in writing of any change in financial condition as soon as possible, but no later than ten (10) days after its occurrence.
The Successful Bidder must make payment within thirty (30) days of TWC’s demand.
Bidder must be set up in the Texas franchise tax system prior to Contract award if applicable.
Bidder must indicate whether or not it holds any financial interest in any Subcontractor.

As a condition of award, an authorized officer or agent of each proposed Subcontractor may be required to sign a statement to the effect that the Subcontractor has read, and will agree to abide by, Bidder’s obligations under any Contract awarded pursuant to this Solicitation.

The Successful Bidder must obtain prior written approval from TWC if any part of the Contract between TWC and the Successful Bidder is to be subcontracted, and the Subcontractor must comply with all applicable requirements of TWC.
Bidder must fully and completely address all requirements described in this Solicitation.
Incomplete or partial Bids will not be considered.
Bidder shall prepare a Bid that clearly and concisely represents its qualifications and capabilities.
Bidders must notify the Sole Point of Contact, Section 4.1, of any ambiguity, conflict, discrepancy, exclusionary specification, omission, or other error in the IFB.
